description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the PerformanceReviewService in the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It contains unit tests for methods related to performance reviews, including DAO retrieval, key generation, review activation, and exception handling.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the PerformanceReviewService methods, including validation, DAO retrieval, and exception scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of PerformanceReviewService and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewDao
methods.description: Verifies that getPerformanceReviewDao() returns an instance of PerformanceReviewDao.

methods.name: testGenerateReviewReviewerRatingKey
methods.description: Checks that generateReviewReviewerRatingKey() produces the expected key string.

methods.name: testActivateReviewWithException1
methods.description: Tests that activateReview() throws an exception when the review lacks a job title.

methods.name: testActivateReviewWithException2
methods.description: Tests that activateReview() throws an exception when the review lacks KPIs.

methods.name: testUpdateActivateReviewWithException1
methods.description: Tests exception when updating activation for a past employee as reviewer.

methods.name: testUpdateActivateReviewWithException2
methods.description: Tests exception for invalid supervisor during update of review activation.
